verdict.note: the calibrated scorer's realised risk is 0.410256 against alpha=0.05; the gate does NOT hold and no risk-control wording may ship

calibration_verdict.reason: informational bucket alpha=0.05, operating-point target 2%. The overlap confidence signal saturates at 1.0 for 74% of queries, so the dev-fitted conformal quantile collapses to q_hat=0.0 and the threshold (1.0) answers exactly the saturated set, whose realised error rate on the held-out split is 22.3% - four times the 5% alpha. Risk control did not hold.

secondary.note: schema-fallback arm, NOT directly comparable: deepseek-flash rejects response_format=json_schema, so the generator ran through the schema-fallback path and 61/148 answered turns produced no parsed claims at all (primary: 7/148). Its judged metrics measure the parse path as much as the model; it is reported separately and excluded from headline comparisons.
